scripts.dev: npm run build -w @jongno/shared && concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev -w @jongno/api" "npm run dev -w @jongno/admin-web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @jongno/shared && npm run build -w @jongno/api && npm run build -w @jongno/admin-web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @jongno/shared && npm run test -w @jongno/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @jongno/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
